title: RaD producers with fixed reversed geometry: conditional κ = 4.099494519e-5 > 2^-15
body:
Combining RaD / hipotures's alternating producers from #41 with the explicit fixed bases and copied reversed corners from #40 gives, under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{4099494519}{10^{14}}=4.099494519\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.$$

This is **1.6193275% above #41's stronger alternating candidate** `4.034168124e-5`. It compares conditional exponent savings, not practical runtime or a global optimum.

The new work composes the changed producers with both fixed `I+J` bases. It regenerates the entire original-envelope local profile at each dimension, verifies the actual event-slot carrier schedules independently, and transfers the new matrices through #40's existing explicit common-basis geometry. RaD's changed graphs and alternating point policy are credited and pinned, not claimed as our own construction.

- All 68,186 h23 and 91,732 h25 local transition profiles pass the five-prime CRT checks; original roles are 36,685 / 48,479. Equal positive-label role totals are not used as substitute profiles.
- The unchanged source-line family uses #40's full 4,073,300-pair geometry certificate. Complete original scalar, frame, source/sink, retained-center and event-slot checks bind the new graphs to that contract.
- Every rank-(h-1) copied transform and all N paid endpoint corrections remain charged. W=178,378,409; total rank=102,565,738,275.
- Exact rational moments, all 47 strict assembly constraints and seven margins pass. Complex saving remains 717/10^7; semantic precision retains scalar gates, C1=1 and p^2000 row stock.

**Validation: full `make verify` PASSED** at research commit `c6fc08951c1776a9685802b1810a2f15dbbd4f64`: **215 tests**, all 12 new focused tests, fresh exhaustive 4,073,300-pair geometry, fresh changed-producer/profile and independent full-dimension dirty-basis audits, inherited rebuilds, and **18 historical patch checks**. Completed 2026-10-08T14:04:19.135020+00:00; log SHA256 `0c644851dfd99d94bd87177307acba9ab54c30691a0e6240238c6fd030cfece8`. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/rad-fixed-reversed/research/rad-fixed-reversed/validation.json). The inherited analytic, all-size physical/tape, routing, prime/native-table and eventual setup obligations remain. Finite tests are not formal verification or external expert acceptance of the complete theorem.

Proof, source pins, exact certificate and commands: `research/rad-fixed-reversed/README.md`. The focused patch applies to #40 at `e3bf3ab0cb1ec48588e279b31a97e7a49c72f99e`. No inherited manuscript is altered.

RaD input source: #41 at `d9c96297d455053b795ee58ba108d5cf892e1c04`, checkpoint `7e488e6b25dc1713c1f41baaf1cefbf677507cf3`; live #41 head `03bde70c0c2a453f1ceae20c619b602841405467` adds only a PR body. Four producer combinations were compared; no global search claim.
